So I Downloaded this game and i was greeted with a login screen, ufortunately there is no audio adjust on this page so there is a chance you might go death by the login page WARNING TO HEADPHONE USERS.!!!

I had to reduce the sound on my windows so i can have a normal amount sacrificing my discord call with my friends inside. 
There was no way to skip the intro neither so i was pretty p**sed.

Anyway, when i selected my class character the whole game had crashed and on the 3rd attempt i gave up 
Fix the game otherwise its a big nope from me.

TL;DR: Don't waste your time, Warframe is not worth it in the end.
They sold out to China; no real support to help you; AI system will police your every word.

Warframe is an always online game with tons of content and regular updates.
It is the best in its genre and no one can come even close (Destiny ew).

Dozens of Warframes, each offering unique playstyles. Some differ so much they feel like you are playing a completely different game and genre.
Hundreds of guns & weapons of all types (except axes for some reason) and even more build options to experiment.
This game is massive.

Sounds good so far, but then what is the problem?
Two very crucial and critical issues:
1) Developers are in a mad dash to pump out updates without fixing issues.
2) Abysmal customer support and constant fear for your account safety.


1) Updates and technical issues:
I get it, Warframe is a live-service game and the devs are very afraid of falling off. 
As of today, the game is 11 years old, that is considered ancient for live-services.
The game is surviving purely on its reputation by now and riding the coattails of their past goodwill remains. A fleeting glory.
   DE constantly release new warframes, weapons and updates to keep the player base engaged, but in doing so, they completely forget and abandon the previous update.
Meaning that balance is broken and new bugs are introduced that aren't fixed in YEARS!
But if there is something that can be even slightly exploited in the players favor, they fix it within a week! This proves they are capable and aware, but simply refusing to do their job!!
   They acknowledge 5 year old bugs in their update notes and promise to fix them, only to have the fix break in the first 2 weeks and they abandon this topic for another 3+ years!

DE still believes that they are a cute "LITTLE INDIE COMPANY UWU :3" and want to reap the benefits and have our patience.
But Warfame grew way too much and DE sold out to TENCENT!
Their teams are larger, the money moves in multi-millions!!
This ain't your "Mom's and Pop's" lil indie title anymore!!!

The content they release now is mostly targeted at new players and cosmetics.
Veterans have been suffering from drought for years !!
Only recently they have finally started giving us end-game content and fixing their systems.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

2) Horrible customer support:
For such a huge game, DE chose to completely AUTOMATE their customer services. Meaning that you are at the mercy of algorithms and bots that do not understand your issue and simply chose to ban or kick you.
   I know this is a current trend to save money in the industry, but even back then in World of Warcraft you had GM (game masters) who would take each case one by one individually.
We are not asking for complete support like this, but at least to not throw the entire player base down the automated bot meat grinder!
We are not treated as gamers or customers. We are just consumers and pigs for the slaughter in DE's eyes.
They are an inch away from milking us like other P2W or mobile games do. The only thing stopping them is their reputation that they are desperately hanging on to.

The customer management system is COMPLETELY automated, there is no way for you to receive any help. You will be speaking to a bot who will redirect you back to customer management which will repeat this infinite cycle!

Any "perceived" negativity in chat is considered an offense and you are banned.
Context or simple frustration does not matter. The chat is a LITERAL minefield.
No wonder people are so afraid of communicating using the in-game chat!!
(best to just play with your guild on discord, otherwise get banned for no reason)

Freedom of speech is suppressed at every corner, each of your words can be misconstrued as hate speech by the automated system and trolls abusing it.
Examples:
   a) There is a zaw weapon in the game called [Balla]. If you type in the chat the name of the weapon, that DE designed and named themselves, you will get banned because for some reason in some country or some language that word is considered offensive.
Excuse me what?!?! DE named it.  I will never forgive them for this.
   b) DE also wants to be so very progressive and inclusive! Celebrating pride month every year and making a big deal out of it. YET, when in a calm and civilized conversation a girl in chat admitted she was lesbian. Guess what?
The system kicked her and stated reason "homophobia"! HAHAHA smh
   c) A similar case, a dude admitted he was black and from an African country, he was banned for "racism" !  HAHAHA  What is this absolute nonsense!?!
   d) You can pay in-game currency to give a name to weapons, people give them all kinds of offensive or troll names. Yet when among all the "edgy" named weapons, I call my machete the "Massacre", they kick me and remove the name without reimbursing me my currency!!

Many Warframe content creators were dropped from the partner program because they have spoken out and pointed at the years old flaws in the hopes of improving the game. Factually correct and valid criticism is utterly ignored. All they got was the boot.

DE can also ban you without giving a reason. Some players have lost their accounts for 15 years! Recently an endurance youtuber played the endless mode mission in the game for more than 20 hours, DE banned him for that! Because hey they don't know if he is cheating/hacking to get this much loot or just playing how the system allows to be played. DE outright admitted that they won't look for differences and will simply ban you because it is easier. It is easier to scare the player base from PLAYING than to actually doing some investigation into these RARE cases. How conceited and lazy of them!


But the worst of it all, is how getting into an altercation with toxic players, even if you do not engage in profanity or otherwise, each side reports the other.
The system does not care if you are 100% innocent or if the toxic players were rude racist sending DEATH THREATS. You ALL get banned. I repeat, EVERYONE gets banned.
Sure, they will get their account suspended for 2 weeks with further threats, but the innocent person will still receive 3-7 days ban just because you were in the VICINITY.
   To DE it is Quantity over quality. You can go to chat and jokingly ask everyone to report you, by the end of the day you will have a 2 weeks ban and threats of losing your account forever..
------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Warframe grew to become something truly amazing, putting most triple-A titles and their companies to shame.
Only to fall and join them while hypocritically believing to still be better than them.

The game has lots of content and offers cool and unique gameplay.
I would like to recommend this game to others but it simply is not worth it anymore.
You might enjoy the start of the journey but in the end you will end up disappointed.

This game is no different from other "Free 2 Play" time wasters like World of Tanks or trash games like Raid Shadow Legends.
It is a poison.
My choice of poison that a veteran like me won't abandon so easily YET.
But I am on a way to rehabilitation, playing less of this ♥♥♥♥ and more of other better games.
UPDATE: They still as trashy as ever, no matter how many updates DE releases.

Fun movement and some neat combat ideas, but:

The environment is not conducive to said movement system
It's gameplay extremely repetitive
Is a visual mess
Requires absurd time investments
Explains next to nothing to new players
Has pitfalls, traps, and abusive systems to try and frustrate you into spending money
Has mobile game style wait times on getting new gear
Progression is locked to resources you get randomly
The real money currency is horribly overpriced, most characters being worth around 35-65$
progression is also cripplingly slow
The U.I. is TERRIBLE, and completely non-customizable 
The story is bland and aimless
The game is buggy and glitchy
Many of the bugs have been in the game years

It's not worth your time, and certainly not worth your money.
